passages.text: “When anyone brings a grain offering to the LORD, his offering must consist of fine flour. He is to pour olive oil on it, put frankincense on it, and bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the frankincense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
A person may want to bring a grain offering to the LORD.
This offering must be made of fine flour.
The person must pour olive oil on the flour.
The person must put frankincense on the flour.
The person must bring the offering to Aaron’s sons.
Aaron’s sons are the priests.
The priest will take a handful of the flour and oil.
The priest will take all the frankincense with it.
The priest will burn this portion on the altar.
This is a memorial portion.
This is an offering made by fire.
This offering gives a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.original: וְנֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי־ תַקְרִ֞יב קָרְבַּ֤ן מִנְחָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת יִהְיֶ֣ה קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְיָצַ֤ק עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְנָתַ֥ן עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָֽה׃ וֶֽהֱבִיאָ֗הּ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹן֮ הַכֹּהֲנִים֒ וְקָמַ֨ץ מִשָּׁ֜ם מְלֹ֣א קֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסָּלְתָּהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־ לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ אַזְכָּרָתָהּ֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
His sons are priests.
The grain offering is a gift to the LORD.
The priest burns part of the grain offering on the altar.
The fire on the altar is for the LORD.
The priest does not burn all of the grain offering.
The remainder of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons.
This remainder is very holy.
It is a most holy part of the offerings made by fire to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֙רֶת֙ מִן־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Now if you bring an offering of grain baked in an oven, it must consist of fine flour, either unleavened cakes mixed with oil or unleavened wafers coated with oil.
passages.sermon:
A person may bring a grain offering to the LORD.
This offering may be baked in an oven.
The offering must use fine flour.
The person may bring unleavened cakes made with fine flour.
These cakes must be mixed with oil.
The person may also bring unleavened wafers made with fine flour.
These wafers must be coated with oil.
passages.original: וְכִ֥י תַקְרִ֛ב קָרְבַּ֥ן מִנְחָ֖ה מַאֲפֵ֣ה תַנּ֑וּר סֹ֣לֶת חַלּ֤וֹת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֥ים בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃ס

passages.text: If your offering is a grain offering prepared on a griddle, it must be unleavened bread made of fine flour mixed with oil.
passages.sermon:
A person may bring a grain offering to God.
The person may prepare this offering on a griddle.
The offering must be unleavened bread.
The bread must be made of fine flour.
The flour must be mixed with oil.
passages.original: וְאִם־ מִנְחָ֥ה עַל־ הַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן מַצָּ֥ה תִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.
passages.sermon:
This instruction is for a grain offering to the LORD.
Take the bread from the griddle.
Break the bread into pieces.
Pour oil on the pieces.
This is a grain offering.
passages.original: פָּת֤וֹת אֹתָהּ֙ פִּתִּ֔ים וְיָצַקְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ שָׁ֑מֶן מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃ס

passages.text: If your offering is a grain offering cooked in a pan, it must consist of fine flour with oil.
passages.sermon:
A grain offering is a gift to the LORD.
You may prepare a grain offering in a pan.
If you prepare it in a pan, use fine flour.
Mix the fine flour with oil.
This is how you must make the grain offering in a pan.
passages.original: וְאִם־ מִנְחַ֥ת מַרְחֶ֖שֶׁת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֥לֶת בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן תֵּעָשֶֽׂה׃

passages.text: When you bring to the LORD the grain offering made in any of these ways, it is to be presented to the priest, and he shall take it to the altar.
passages.sermon:
A person brings a grain offering to the LORD.
The grain offering may be prepared in any of the described ways.
The person gives the grain offering to the priest.
The priest takes the grain offering to the altar.
passages.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ֣ אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לַיהוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִגִּישָׁ֖הּ אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: The priest is to remove the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
A priest serves God at the altar.
The priest takes a grain offering.
He removes a memorial portion from the grain offering.
He burns this portion on the altar.
The fire consumes the offering.
The smoke rises as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהֵרִ֨ים הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִן־ הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת־ אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: But the remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
\r\nAaron had sons who served as priests.
\r\nThe grain offering was a gift to the LORD.
\r\nThe priest burned part of the grain offering on the altar.
\r\nThe priest did not burn all of the grain offering.
\r\nThe remainder of the grain offering belonged to Aaron and his sons.
\r\nThis remainder was a most holy part.
\r\nThis remainder came from the offerings made by fire to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֙רֶת֙ מִן־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: No grain offering that you present to the LORD may be made with leaven, for you are not to burn any leaven or honey as an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
A grain offering is a gift to the LORD.
You must not make any grain offering with leaven.
You must not burn leaven on the altar for the LORD.
You must not burn honey on the altar for the LORD.
Leaven and honey are not allowed in offerings made by fire to the LORD.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּקְרִ֙יבוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א תֵעָשֶׂ֖ה חָמֵ֑ץ כִּ֤י כָל־ שְׂאֹר֙ וְכָל־ דְּבַ֔שׁ לֹֽא־ תַקְטִ֧ירוּ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: You may bring them to the LORD as an offering of firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws about offerings.
\r\nGod commanded the people to bring offerings of firstfruits to Him.
\r\nYou may bring your firstfruits as an offering to the LORD.
\r\nYou must not place these firstfruits offerings on the altar.
\r\nThese firstfruits offerings will not be burned as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.original: קָרְבַּ֥ן רֵאשִׁ֛ית תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לֹא־ יַעֲל֖וּ לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹֽחַ׃

passages.text: And you shall season each of your grain offerings with salt. You must not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offering; you are to add salt to each of your offerings.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel instructions for grain offerings.
You must add salt to every grain offering you bring.
Do not leave out the salt of the covenant with your God from your grain offering.
You must offer salt with all your offerings.
passages.original: וְכָל־ קָרְבַּ֣ן מִנְחָתְךָ֮ בַּמֶּ֣לַח תִּמְלָח֒ וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֗ית מֶ֚לַח בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מֵעַ֖ל מִנְחָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ל כָּל־ קָרְבָּנְךָ֖ תַּקְרִ֥יב מֶֽלַח׃ס

passages.text: If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD, you shall offer crushed heads of new grain roasted on the fire.
passages.sermon:
A person may bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD.
The person must use new grain.
The person must crush the heads of the new grain.
The person must roast the crushed grain on the fire.
The person must offer this roasted, crushed new grain as the grain offering of firstfruits.
passages.original: וְאִם־ תַּקְרִ֛יב מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה אָבִ֞יב קָל֤וּי בָּאֵשׁ֙ גֶּ֣רֶשׂ כַּרְמֶ֔ל תַּקְרִ֕יב אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: And you are to put oil and frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.
passages.sermon:
This law describes a grain offering to the LORD.
You must put oil on the grain offering.
You must also put frankincense on it.
This is a grain offering.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֤ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָ֑ה מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃

passages.text: The priest shall then burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all its frankincense, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes a portion of the grain offering.
He takes some of the crushed grain.
He takes some of the oil.
He takes all of the frankincense.
The priest burns these on the altar.
He offers them as a fire offering to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ אַזְכָּרָתָ֗הּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־ לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ
